sections.title: Sound of bt
paragraphs: The letter group -bt sounds like /t/. It has one sound. You hear it at the end of (debt) /dɛt/, which means money that you owe. The first letter in this group makes no sound. You hear only the ending sound in (debt) /dɛt/.

sections.title: How to say bt
paragraphs: Touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with the tip of your tongue. Stop the air for a moment. Then let the air burst out quickly. Keep your lips relaxed and slightly open. Do not use your voice. Touch your throat, and you will feel no vibration.

sections.title: Spelling of bt
paragraphs: The letters bt appear at the end of a word or before an ending. The first letter is a silent letter, which means a letter that you write but do not say. You pronounce only the ending consonant as /t/. You hear this in (doubt) /daʊt/.

sections.title: Common bt mistakes
paragraphs: Do not close your lips to say the first letter. Keep your mouth ready for the ending sound. Moving your lips makes an extra beat. Go straight from the vowel to the final sound, as in (debt) /dɛt/.
